ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' DLL side-loading via signed loader in user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts Lazarus Group's hallmark execution chain — a legitimately-named/signed third-party binary dropped by a fake-job-offer ISO/archive lure side-loading a malicious DLL (e.g. PotPlayer.dll, DUI70.dll, the 3CX ffmpeg.dll/d3dcompiler_47.dll pair) from the same user-writable directory. The signed-EXE + planted-DLL combo in Downloads/Temp/AppData is the defining Dream Job / TraderTraitor tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("PotPlayer.dll","DUI70.dll","wlbsctrl.dll","version.dll","dbghelp.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","ffmpeg.dll","cryptsp.dll","msvcr100.dll","colorui.dll")) AND (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
// Lazarus plants the malicious DLL next to a legit signed loader in a user-writable dir
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\")
| where FileName in~ ("potplayer.dll","dui70.dll","wlbsctrl.dll","version.dll","dbghelp.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","ffmpeg.dll","cryptsp.dll","msvcr100.dll","colorui.dll")
// loader binary itself runs from the same abnormal location (not System32 / Program Files)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          LegitLoader = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          SideLoadedDll = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath,
          DllSHA256 = SHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Sentinel has no image-load table; detect the side-load DLL being dropped next to its loader
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFileName in~ ("potplayer.dll","dui70.dll","wlbsctrl.dll","version.dll","dbghelp.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","ffmpeg.dll","cryptsp.dll","msvcr100.dll","colorui.dll")
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName,
          ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus DLL Side-Load DLL Dropped in User-Writable Path
id: 7b2c9d14-3f6a-4e88-9c21-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a known Lazarus side-loading DLL in a user-writable directory, the precursor to DLL search-order hijack against a co-located signed loader.
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\PotPlayer.dll'
      - '\DUI70.dll'
      - '\wlbsctrl.dll'
      - '\version.dll'
      - '\dbghelp.dll'
      - '\d3dcompiler_47.dll'
      - '\ffmpeg.dll'
      - '\cryptsp.dll'
      - '\msvcr100.dll'
      - '\colorui.dll'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Temp\'
  condition: selection_name and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installers extracting redistributable DLLs to temp
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\PotPlayer.dll OR *\potplayer.dll OR *\DUI70.dll OR *\dui70.dll OR *\wlbsctrl.dll OR *\version.dll OR *\dbghelp.dll OR *\d3dcompiler_47.dll OR *\ffmpeg.dll OR *\cryptsp.dll OR *\msvcr100.dll OR *\colorui.dll) AND @TargetFilename:(*\Downloads\* OR *\AppData\* OR *\Public\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\Temp\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(PotPlayer|DUI70|wlbsctrl|version|dbghelp|d3dcompiler_47|ffmpeg|cryptsp|msvcr100|colorui)\.dll$/i
| regex("\\\\(Downloads|Temp|AppData|Public|ProgramData)\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Anchors on the exact signed-loader/planted-DLL pairs documented across Lazarus Dream Job, the 3CX supply-chain compromise (ffmpeg.dll/d3dcompiler_47.dll), and PotPlayer fake-job lures, combined with the user-writable execution path that distinguishes the lure-dropped copy from a legit install. Generic side-load rules omit the actor's specific DLL inventory and fire on every benign app folder.

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus / Diamond Sleet BYOVD: vulnerable-driver kernel service registration (FudModule)
ucs.description: Hunts Lazarus Group's Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver step used to load the FudModule rootkit and blind EDR — registration of a kernel-mode service whose ImagePath points at a known-abusable signed driver (ene.sys, dbutil_2_3.sys, mhyprot2.sys, etc.) or any .sys staged in a user-writable directory. This admin-to-kernel pivot is a signature Diamond Sleet defense-evasion move.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\*" Registry.registry_value_name="ImagePath" AND (Registry.registry_value_data IN ("*ene.sys*","*dbutil_2_3.sys*","*mhyprot2.sys*","*viragt64.sys*","*ucorew64.sys*","*rentdrv2.sys*","*gdrv.sys*") OR (Registry.registry_value_data="*.sys*" AND (Registry.registry_value_data IN ("*\\Temp\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\Downloads\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*")))) by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has @"\Services\"
| where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
| where RegistryValueData endswith ".sys"
// known BYOVD drivers Lazarus abuses, OR any driver staged in a user-writable path
| where RegistryValueData has_any ("ene.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","mhyprot2.sys","viragt64.sys","ucorew64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gdrv.sys")
    or RegistryValueData has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\AppData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","setup.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ServiceKey = RegistryKey, DriverPath = RegistryValueData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4697   // A service was installed in the system
| where ServiceType has "kernel" or ServiceFileName endswith ".sys"
| where ServiceFileName has_any ("ene.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","mhyprot2.sys","viragt64.sys","ucorew64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gdrv.sys")
    or ServiceFileName has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\AppData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ServiceName, ServiceFileName, ServiceType, ServiceStartType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Kernel Service Registration
id: c4e1a8b2-9d77-4f30-8a6e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects registration of a kernel service ImagePath pointing at a known-abusable signed driver or a .sys staged in a user-writable path, consistent with Lazarus/Diamond Sleet FudModule BYOVD loading.
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\ImagePath'
  selection_driver:
    Details|contains:
      - 'ene.sys'
      - 'dbutil_2_3.sys'
      - 'mhyprot2.sys'
      - 'viragt64.sys'
      - 'ucorew64.sys'
      - 'rentdrv2.sys'
      - 'gdrv.sys'
  selection_path:
    Details|contains:
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
    Details|endswith: '.sys'
  condition: selection_key and (selection_driver or selection_path)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate kernel driver installs from vendor MSI packages
level: high
tags:
  - attack.privilege-escalation
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1543.003
  - attack.t1562.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\ene.sys OR *\ENE.sys OR *\dbutil_2_3.sys OR *\mhyprot2.sys OR *\Mhyprot2.sys OR *\viragt64.sys OR *\ucorew64.sys OR *\rentdrv2.sys OR *\gdrv.sys) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*.sys OR *.SYS) AND @TargetFilename:(*\Temp\* OR *\AppData\* OR *\Public\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\Downloads\*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| RegObjectName=/\\Services\\/i
| RegValueName=/^ImagePath$/i
| RegStringValue=/\.sys/i
| RegStringValue=/(ene|dbutil_2_3|mhyprot2|viragt64|ucorew64|rentdrv2|gdrv)\.sys|\\(Temp|AppData|Public|Downloads|ProgramData)\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, RegStringValue], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Lazarus/Diamond Sleet is one of the few state crews that routinely chains admin access into kernel via BYVOD to deploy the FudModule rootkit and disable Defender/EDR callbacks — matching their published driver inventory plus user-writable staging captures both the named-driver case and renamed-driver variants, where generic 'service installed' rules drown in legit vendor driver installs.
